name: std::system_error::operator=
intro: Assigns the contents with those of other. If *this and other both have dynamic type std::system_error then std::strcmp(what(), other.what()) == 0 after assignment.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
other

 -

 another system_error object to assign with
